title: fix(ui): keep failed-run detail truncation surrogate-safe
body:
## What Problem This Solves

A session progress card's short failed-run or failed-child detail can end with a broken replacement glyph when its existing 240-unit UTF-16 cap splits an emoji's surrogate pair.

## What Changed

Use the existing `truncateUtf16Safe` after the unchanged `formatUiExternalText` selection and redaction pipeline. Keep the 240-unit cap, selected inputs, unavailable behavior and all saved plan/runtime state unchanged. No permission, Gateway, schema, SDK, or approval changes.

Preserve both contributor commits. Consolidate the regression into the existing retained-runtime update cases for composer, details and board cards instead of adding a separate test. Test source is net zero lines. Document the existing short-detail cap and surrogate-preserving truncation.

## Evidence

[Built Control UI browser results, inspected before/after screenshots, and inherited CI receipt](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/190288#issuecomment-6558809137).

- Secretless Node 24.22.1 Docker; built application, real Linux Chromium and maintained mocked Gateway.
- Main twice/candidate twice for failed-parent and failed-child inputs. Main produces 240 units with an unpaired high surrogate; candidate produces 239 well-formed units ending in the preceding whole emoji.
- Short text, ASCII cap, redaction, parent-versus-child selection, stale input and disconnected/unavailable controls passed unchanged on both refs.
- 37 focused component cases passed. Changed-file Oxfmt/Oxlint and `git diff --check` passed.
- Prior contributor-head `check-lint-core-5` failure is the independently witnessed workshop type-argument error; receipt posted, no rerun or unrelated repair.

Production +11/-7 (net +4); tests +3/-3 (net 0); docs +3.

## Merge Danger

Two-way door: reverting fully restores the prior preview formatting. No persisted state or protocol changes. Blast radius is the short runtime-error detail on session progress cards; text source selection, redaction and run/child status remain unchanged.
